0.0: Hello #h0#. Do you know about the #bMonster Collection#k that was recently added? I'll explain what it is and even give you a freebie!
0.1: The Monster Collection is #ba book of collectible monsters in Maple World#k. Various monsters can be added to it, like normal monsters, elite monsters, party quest monsters, even boss monsters.\r\nYou can collect monsters with all your characters on the same world.
0.2: You can check the collection book through the #bMonster Collection button from the menu#k or the #bshortcut key#k. \r\nYou can check which monsters you've collected and also claim various items every time you complete a collection.\r\nYou can send monsters you've collected out to explore, and they'll bring back gifts! The longer they explore, the better your gift.
0.3: Now you're probably wondering how you collect monsters.\r\nExplore Maple World and #bdefeat monsters with the same name#k as the ones displayed in the collection book! Or you can use a special item called a #bMonsterbloom#k to collect monsters. #rWould you like to add to your collection by using a Monsterbloom?#k

yes.0: Check your Use tab. Use the #bPoison Flower Monsterbloom#k you got right now to add a new monster to your Monster Collection.

no.0: Are you busy right now? I'll tell you how #bto use the Poison Flower Monsterbloom to add to your Monster Collection#k when you talk to me later.

quest.0: Use Poison Flower Monsterbloom to add a new monster to your Monster Collection.
